title: Structs (Part 1) - Named fields and methods
learning_objectives: Define a named-field struct with appropriate field types.
Construct a struct value and read its public fields.
Add a method that borrows `self` to build a summary string.
Distinguish public fields from private implementation details.
explanation: This slice introduces structs through one small profile type. The lesson combines construction, field visibility, and a borrowing method so the learner can see how data and behavior live together on a named type.

examples.title: Define and construct a named-field struct
Add a borrowing method on the struct
Keep one implementation detail private

compiler_error_examples: error[E0616]: field `display_name` of struct `Profile` is private
error[E0599]: no method named `summary` found for struct `Profile`
completion_criteria: Exercise tests cover construction, field access, method behavior, and an empty-name boundary case
Learner can explain why `summary(&self)` borrows the struct instead of consuming it
Learner can identify why the private display field is not part of the public API
